# Processed Gossypol COSY, NMRPipe

`nmrpipe_2d_cosy_example.ft2` is the 512 × 2048 real-real processed COSY
plane from [nmrXiv CENAPTNMR P33](https://doi.org/10.57992/nmrxiv.p33),
[Gossypol sample S213](https://nmrxiv.org/sample/S213), licensed under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

The TopSpin `pdata/1/2rr` and physical axes were converted to NMRPipe by
[nmrglue-ng's conversion script](https://github.com/spectrochempy/nmrglue-ng/blob/14f5ee8b06592060a987cbd12f79c6e9a36c8a20/tests/fixtures/fileio/convert_bruker_cosy_to_pipe.py).
This file is copied unchanged from that revision, not reconstructed from raw
FID data. It supports the NMRPipe reading and 2D analysis examples.

See `../example-data.sha256` for its checksum and `../PROVENANCE.md` for scope.
